_about: Deliberate exceptions to test/adminExposure.test.js: a setting or announcement field that is accepted by the server but has no admin control. Every entry needs a reason and EITHER an expiry date (YYYY-MM-DD, the test fails after it so the exception gets revisited) OR permanent:true for an internal marker. Add a control instead whenever you can.
